name: kml-upsert
description: UPSERT: shallow-merge of attributes and metadata onto an existing link, engine-maintained _version, the schema preflight that prevents partial writes, id-matcher error paths, the self-loop guard, and the refusal to write reserved `_` metadata.
setup: UPSERT { CONCEPT ?drug_type { {type: "$ConceptType", name: "Drug"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "description": "Pharmaceutical drug concept type" } } WITH METADATA { "source": "test_setup", "confidence": 1.0 } }

UPSERT { CONCEPT ?symptom_type { {type: "$ConceptType", name: "Symptom"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "description": "Medical symptom concept type" } } WITH METADATA { "source": "test_setup", "confidence": 1.0 } }
UPSERT { CONCEPT ?treats_pred { {type: "$PropositionType", name: "treats"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "description": "Treatment relationship" } } WITH METADATA { "source": "test_setup", "confidence": 1.0 } }
UPSERT { CONCEPT ?headache { {type: "Symptom", name: "Headache"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "severity": "moderate", "duration": "2-4 hours" } } WITH METADATA { "source": "test_data", "confidence": 1.0 } }
UPSERT { CONCEPT ?fever { {type: "Symptom", name: "Fever"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "temperature_range": "38-40°C", "common": true } } WITH METADATA { "source": "test_data", "confidence": 0.9 } }

UPSERT { CONCEPT ?aspirin { {type: "Drug", name: "Aspirin"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "molecular_formula": "C9H8O4", "risk_level": 2, "dosage": "325mg" } SET PROPOSITIONS { ("treats", {type: "Symptom", name: "Headache"}) ("treats", {type: "Symptom", name: "Fever"}) } } } WITH METADATA { "source": "test_data", "confidence": 0.95 }

cases.name: SET ATTRIBUTES from the setup are readable
SET PROPOSITIONS links inherit the statement metadata and start at version 1
upserting an existing proposition returns its link id
cases.command: UPSERT { PROPOSITION ?treatment { ({type: "Drug", name: "Aspirin"}, "treats", {type: "Symptom", name: "Headache"}) SET ATTRIBUTES { "effectiveness": 0.85, "onset_time": "30 minutes" } } WITH METADATA { "source": "clinical_trial", "study_id": "CT-2024-001" } }

cases.name: the second upsert shallow-merges metadata and advances _version
an unregistered predicate in SET PROPOSITIONS is a type mismatch
cases.command: UPSERT { CONCEPT ?bad_drug { {type: "Drug", name: "BadDrug"} SET PROPOSITIONS { ("not_registered", {type: "Symptom", name: "Headache"}) } } }

cases.name: the rejected statement created no concept
the preflight rejects a statement whose later block is invalid
the earlier block of the rejected statement was not applied
a concept {id:} matcher for a missing node reports not found
a proposition (id:) matcher rejects a concept id
a proposition (id:) matcher for a missing link reports not found
subject and object of a proposition must differ

error.message: Subject and object cannot be the same

cases.name: a SET PROPOSITIONS self-loop is rejected by the preflight
cases.command: UPSERT { CONCEPT ?x { {type: "Drug", name: "Aspirin"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "poisoned": true } SET PROPOSITIONS { ("treats", {type: "Drug", name: "Aspirin"}) } } }

cases.name: the rejected self-loop statement left no partial attribute write
reserved _version cannot be written from block metadata
reserved _updated_at cannot be written on a proposition
cases.command: UPSERT { PROPOSITION ?p { ({type: "Drug", name: "Aspirin"}, "treats", {type: "Symptom", name: "Headache"}) } WITH METADATA { "_updated_at": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z" } }

cases.name: a successful upsert of an existing concept returns its id
the mutation advanced the concept _version from 1 to 2
